title: Measles-like hypermutation of a Newcastle disease virus drives fatal encephalitis during BCMA × CD3 T-cell-redirecting immunotherapy.
abstract: Abstract Newcastle disease virus (NDV or AOaV-1) is an avian paramyxovirus that typically causes only mild, self-limiting disease in humans. Here, we report fatal neuroinvasive AOaV-1 infection in a patient with multiple myeloma receiving maintenance therapy with teclistamab, daratumumab, and lenalidomide following frontline teclistamab-based treatment and autologous stem cell transplantation. Following rapidly progressive brainstem–cerebellar encephalitis and negative conventional microbiological testing, unbiased metagenomic RNA sequencing of a cerebellar biopsy identified AOaV-1 at high intraparenchymal abundance. Viral genome analysis revealed striking A-to-G and U-to-C substitutions selectively concentrated in the matrix gene, consistent with ADAR-mediated RNA editing. Long-read sequencing resolved two genetically distinct, independently hypermutated CNS haplotypes. Post-mortem analysis demonstrated widespread dissemination and continued viral diversification in multiple brain regions, whereas a peripheral urine sample contained a minimally mutated putative ancestral lineage. These findings support peripheral infection followed by CNS seeding and compartmentalized within-host evolution. The selective matrix-gene hypermutation closely parallels persistent measles virus infection in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis, revealing a shared mechanism of paramyxovirus adaptation to the CNS. Profound immunotherapy-associated immune dysfunction may thus create niches enabling normally low-pathogenic zoonotic viruses to persist, evolve, and acquire severe neurovirulence.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a fatal encephalitis caused by a Newcastle disease virus (NDV) in a patient with multiple myeloma undergoing immunotherapy. The study highlights the potential for normally low-pathogenic zoonotic viruses to acquire severe neurovirulence through immune dysfunction. Using metagenomic RNA sequencing and long-read sequencing, the researchers identified hypermutated viral genomes in the central nervous system (CNS) and a minimally mutated lineage in peripheral tissues. The findings suggest that immune suppression during treatment may allow zoonotic viruses to persist, evolve, and cause severe neurological disease, similar to measles virus in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis. The study's limitations include its single-case design and reliance on post-mortem analysis, which may not capture the full in vivo dynamics. The evidence supports a mechanism of paramyxovirus adaptation to the CNS, with implications for understanding viral evolution in immunocompromised hosts.

title: Phylogeography and transmission dynamics of the 2025-2026 Utah-Arizona measles outbreak: a retrospective genomic epidemiology study
abstract: Background: Measles outbreaks are increasing in frequency globally as vaccine coverage decreases. During the 2025-26 Utah-Arizona border outbreak, identifying where and between whom transmission occurred was essential for directing control measures. However, epidemiological data alone are not sufficient to infer transmission patterns. Methods: As part of the local and state-wide outbreak investigation, we conducted amplicon-based whole genome sequencing on residual diagnostic samples from confirmed measles cases collected from June 15, 2025-April 30, 2026. We reconstructed viral dispersal across Utah using Bayesian phylogeographic analyses. We evaluated genetic distance thresholds for identifying recent transmission by comparing single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP)-based genetic clusters with known epidemiologic linkages. We then assessed pairwise exposures associated with genetically supported transmission linkage using logistic regression, accounting for network and spatial dependence between pairs. Findings: We generated 509 high-quality whole measles virus genomes from 913 patients. In 2025, most viral dispersal events (67.9%) originated in Southwest Utah and Mohave County, Arizona, where the first cases were reported. By 2026, most viral spread (60.5%) occurred outside of this area. A threshold of 0 SNPs identified epidemiologically linked pairs of individuals with a sensitivity of 77.4% and specificity of 92.3%. Household membership (odds ratio (OR): 219.10, 95% credible interval (CI): 112.66-325.53), participation in the same sport (OR: 15.19, 95% CI: 9.75-20.63), and attendance at the same school (OR: 51.5, 95% CI: 36.38-66.61) were independently associated with transmission linkage. Increasing distance between households was associated with reduced odds of linkage (OR: 0.46: 95% CI 0.44-0.48). Interpretation: Repeated introductions of measles virus from southwestern Utah seeded transmission elsewhere in Utah, with household, school, and sports exposures contributing to onward transmission. Validated genome-based linkage measures can complement contact tracing by helping public health teams identify likely transmission networks and prioritize investigation when resources are constrained.

title_zh: 2025-2026 犹他州-亚利桑那州 麻疹 暴发 的系统发育地理学和 传播 动态:一项回顾性基因组 流行病学 研究
source_body_en: Background: Measles outbreaks are increasing in frequency globally as vaccine coverage decreases. During the 2025-26 Utah-Arizona border outbreak, identifying where and between whom transmission occurred was essential for directing control measures. However, epidemiological data alone are not sufficient to infer transmission patterns. Methods: As part of the local and state-wide outbreak investigation, we conducted amplicon-based whole genome sequencing on residual diagnostic samples from confirmed measles cases collected from June 15, 2025-April 30, 2026. We reconstructed viral dispersal across Utah using Bayesian phylogeographic analyses. We evaluated genetic distance thresholds for identifying recent transmission by comparing single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP)-based genetic clusters with known epidemiologic linkages. We then assessed pairwise exposures associated with genetically supported transmission linkage using logistic regression, accounting for network and spatial dependence between pairs. Findings: We generated 509 high-quality whole measles virus genomes from 913 patients. In 2025, most viral dispersal events (67.9%) originated in Southwest Utah and Mohave County, Arizona, where the first cases were reported. By 2026, most viral spread (60.5%) occurred outside of this area. A threshold of 0 SNPs identified epidemiologically linked pairs of individuals with a sensitivity of 77.4% and specificity of 92.3%. Household membership (odds ratio (OR): 219.10, 95% credible interval (CI): 112.66-325.53), participation in the same sport (OR: 15.19, 95% CI: 9.75-20.63), and attendance at the same school (OR: 51.5, 95% CI: 36.38-66.61) were independently associated with transmission linkage. Increasing distance between households was associated with reduced odds of linkage (OR: 0.46: 95% CI 0.44-0.48). Interpretation: Repeated introductions of measles virus from southwestern Utah seeded transmission elsewhere in Utah, with household, school, and sports exposures contributing to onward transmission. Validated genome-based linkage measures can complement contact tracing by helping public health teams identify likely transmission networks and prioritize investigation when resources are constrained.

title: Vaccination status and its association with complications among the patients admitted with measles in the dedicated measles hospitals, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
abstract: Bangladesh is facing a major resurgence of measles, with more than 60,000 suspected cases and over 600 deaths reported between March and May 2026. Despite the growing outbreak, hospital-based evidence in Bangladesh remains limited regarding measles vaccination status and its association with clinical complications. To address this critical gap, our study aimed to assess the vaccination status and its relationship with the development of clinical complications. This cross-sectional study enrolled 260 children aged 2-72 months with clinically confirmed measles who were admitted to four dedicated measles treatment hospitals in Dhaka, Bangladesh, between 15 and 25 April 2026. Data on vaccination status, sociodemographic characteristics, feeding practices, nutritional status, clinical symptoms, and complications were collected through caregiver interviews and hospital records. Adjusted odds ratios (AOR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were estimated; p < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. Among enrolled children, 74.6% were unvaccinated, 18.8% were partially vaccinated, and only 6.5% were fully vaccinated. In the multivariable model, age below 9 months (aOR 0.09, 95% CI 0.03-0.268, p < 0.001) was independently associated with lower odds of vaccination, while household income at or above the median (aOR 3.983, 95% CI 1.8-8.813, p = 0.004) was associated with higher odds. Complications developed in 31.1% of cases, with respiratory involvement being most common. Absence of exclusive breastfeeding (aOR 2.336, 95% CI 1.027-5.313, p = 0.043) and presenting with exactly three symptoms at admission (aOR 3.106, 95% CI 1.274-7.572, p = 0.013) were independently associated with complications. Unvaccinated children had markedly higher odds of complications than vaccinated children (aOR 5.729, 95% CI: 2.363-13.889, p < 0.001). The heavy burden of measles among unvaccinated children, shaped by socioeconomic disadvantage and suboptimal feeding practices, underscores the urgent need to restore immunization coverage and strengthen equitable health services in Bangladesh.

title: Acceptability and feasibility of measles vaccination, small-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplementation, and their co-delivery among children aged 6–23 months in northern Nigeria: a qualitative study
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Undernutrition and infectious diseases form a vicious cycle that endangers child survival in low-resource settings, including in Northern Nigeria. The NutriVax-Measles trial was designed to evaluate a strategy combining preventive small-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplements (SQ-LNS) distributions with community mobilization and routine immunization services for children aged 6-23 months to improve measles vaccination uptake. To inform future programs co-delivering nutrition supplementation and immunization services at scale, we aimed to assess the feasibility and acceptability of measles vaccination, SQ-LNS distribution, and the NutriVax strategy. Methods A qualitative study was conducted at the end of the trial using in-depth interviews (n=53) and focus group discussions (n=8) with key stakeholders: caregivers, health care workers, community health workers, and community representatives. Thematic analysis was guided by multiple conceptual frameworks. Results The majority of the participants expressed satisfaction with measles vaccines in both arms, and with SQ-LNS in the NutriVax arm, as they perceived the benefits for their children’s health. In both arms, community awareness sessions and previous experience of outbreaks were key to motivating caregivers to bring their children to healthcare centres. Although distance to health facilities was identified as one of the main barriers to accessing care, SQ-LNS was perceived as an important source of motivation to bring their child to the clinic where they subsequently received vaccination. All stakeholder groups emphasized the importance of community leaders’ support and targeted male sensitization to address the prevailing sociocultural norms. Additionally, improved service organization to reduce waiting time was considered crucial to enhance caregivers’ acceptability of the intervention. Conclusion Both measles vaccination and SQ-LNS provision were acceptable and feasible, supporting the NutriVax strategy within primary healthcare settings in fragile health systems. Successful implementation depends on sustained community sensitization, continued engagement of fathers and community leaders, and service delivery decentralized as close as possible to beneficiaries. KEY MESSAGES What is already known? Co-delivering small-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplements (SQ-LNS) with routine immunization is an effective strategy to improve vaccination coverage in Northern Nigeria. Yet, evidence on how vaccination and SQ-LNS are perceived, implemented, and experienced by stakeholders at health-care and community levels remains scarce. What are the new findings? SQ-LNS was an important source of motivation for caregivers to bring their children to health facilities, creating opportunities for vaccination. Persistent barriers to vaccination included socio-cultural misconceptions, gender norms, long waiting time and distance to health facilities. What do the new findings imply? Sustained community engagement, including targeted male sensitization, is important to improve measles vaccination acceptability. Successful implementation of co-delivery programs also requires well-organized service delivery, with services decentralized to health facilities as close as possible to beneficiaries, particularly to reduce travel distances and waiting times.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 营养不良和传染病形成恶性循环,危及资源匮乏地区(包括尼日利亚北部)的儿童生存。NutriVax-麻疹 试验旨在评估一项策略,该策略将预防性小量脂质营养补充剂 (SQ-LNS) 分发与社区动员和针对 6-23 个月儿童的常规免疫服务相结合,以提高 麻疹 疫苗接种 的吸收。为了为未来大规模共同提供营养补充和免疫服务的计划提供信息,我们旨在评估 麻疹 疫苗接种、SQ-LNS 分配和 NutriVax 策略的可行性和可接受性。方法 在试验结束时进行了一项定性研究,采用深入访谈 (n=53) 和焦点小组讨论 (n=8) 的方式与主要利益相关者:护理人员、卫生保健工作者、社区卫生工作者和社区代表进行讨论。主题分析以多个概念框架为指导。结果 大多数参与者对双臂中的 麻疹 疫苗 以及 NutriVax 臂中的 SQ-LNS 表示满意,因为他们认为这对孩子的健康有益。在这两个方面,社区意识会议和 暴发 的先前经验是激励护理人员将孩子带到医疗中心的关键。尽管距医疗机构的距离被认为是获得护理的主要障碍之一,但 SQ-LNS 被认为是带孩子去诊所接受 疫苗接种 治疗的重要动机来源。所有利益相关者团体都强调了社区领袖的支持和有针对性的男性宣传对于解决现行社会文化规范的重要性。此外,改进服务组织以减少等待时间被认为对于提高护理人员对干预措施的可接受性至关重要。结论 麻疹 疫苗接种 和 SQ-LNS 的规定都是可接受且可行的,支持脆弱卫生系统初级医疗机构中的 NutriVax 策略。成功的实施取决于持续的社区宣传、父亲和社区领袖的持续参与以及尽可能将服务交付分散到受益人身边。关键信息 什么是已知的?与常规免疫接种共同提供小量脂质营养补充剂 (SQ-LNS) 是提高尼日利亚北部 疫苗接种 覆盖率的有效策略。然而,关于医疗保健和社区层面的利益相关者如何感知、实施和体验 疫苗接种 和 SQ-LNS 的证据仍然很少。有哪些新发现? title: Susceptibility-weighted imaging findings in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis: subcortical paramagnetic rim and deep gray matter changes.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder caused by persistent measles virus infection. Conventional MRI plays a key role in diagnosis and staging; however, susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI) findings in SSPE have not been systematically characterized, particularly with respect to their relationship to disease burden and neurodegeneration. With this study we aim to evaluate SWI changes in SSPE, with emphasis on the Subcortical Paramagnetic Rim (SPR) and deep gray matter mineralization, and to assess their association with parenchymal disease burden and cerebral atrophy. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 126 patients with confirmed SSPE who underwent MRI including SWI. T2/FLAIR hyperintensities were assessed across predefined supratentorial and infratentorial parenchymal regions. A composite total parenchymal disease burden score was calculated. Cerebral atrophy and deep gray matter mineralization were evaluated using semi-quantitative visual grading systems. SWI was also assessed for the presence of a SPR. Associations between susceptibility findings, parenchymal disease burden, cerebral atrophy, and clinical parameters were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods. RESULTS: SPR was identified in 14 of 128 MRI studies (10.9%), most commonly involving the parietal lobes. Patients with the rim had significantly longer symptom duration, higher disease stage, greater parenchymal disease burden, higher atrophy scores, and higher deep gray matter mineralization scores compared with patients without the rim (p < 0.01). Deep gray matter mineralization scores showed significant positive correlations with both global parenchymal disease burden and cerebral atrophy (Spearman's ρ, p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: SPR and deep gray matter mineralization, are associated with increasing parenchymal disease burden and atrophy. These findings likely represent imaging markers of disease chronicity and provide complementary information to conventional MRI, particularly in the evaluation of chronic encephalitis in measles-endemic regions.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder caused by persistent measles virus infection. Conventional MRI plays a key role in diagnosis and staging; however, susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI) findings in SSPE have not been systematically characterized, particularly with respect to their relationship to disease burden and neurodegeneration.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: This retrospective single-center study included 126 patients with confirmed SSPE who underwent MRI including SWI.
elements_en.methods: T2/FLAIR hyperintensities were assessed across predefined supratentorial and infratentorial parenchymal regions. A composite total parenchymal disease burden score was calculated. Cerebral atrophy and deep gray matter mineralization were evaluated using semi-quantitative visual grading systems. SWI was also assessed for the presence of a SPR. Associations between susceptibility findings, parenchymal disease burden, cerebral atrophy, and clinical parameters were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods.
elements_en.main_results: SPR was identified in 14 of 128 MRI studies (10.9%), most commonly involving the parietal lobes. Patients with the rim had significantly longer symptom duration, higher disease stage, greater parenchymal disease burden, higher atrophy scores, and higher deep gray matter mineralization scores compared with patients without the rim (p < 0.01). Deep gray matter mineralization scores showed significant positive correlations with both global parenchymal disease burden and cerebral atrophy (Spearman's ρ, p < 0.001).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: SPR and deep gray matter mineralization are associated with increasing parenchymal disease burden and atrophy. These findings likely represent imaging markers of disease chronicity and provide complementary information to conventional MRI, particularly in the evaluation of chronic encephalitis in measles-endemic regions.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings provide complementary information to conventional MRI, particularly in the evaluation of chronic encephalitis in measles-endemic regions. They may inform the development of more accurate imaging-based diagnostic and staging tools for SSPE.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is retrospective and based on a single-center cohort, which may limit generalizability. The evidence is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and the reliance on semi-quantitative visual grading systems.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了 126 名确诊为 SSPE 的患者,他们接受了 MRI(包括 SWI)检查。
elements_zh.methods: 在预先确定的幕上和幕下实质区域评估 T2/FLAIR 高信号。计算综合总实质疾病负担评分。使用半定量视觉分级系统评估脑萎缩和深层灰质矿化。还评估了 SWI 是否存在 SPR。使用非参数统计方法分析了敏感性结果、实质疾病负担、脑萎缩和临床参数之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 128 项 MRI 研究中有 14 项(10.9%)发现了 SPR,最常见的是顶叶。与无边缘患者相比,有边缘患者的症状持续时间明显更长、疾病分期更高、实质疾病负担更大、萎缩评分更高、深部灰质矿化评分更高(p < 0.01)。深部灰质矿化评分与整体实质疾病负担和脑萎缩呈显着正相关(Spearman's ρ,p < 0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: SPR 和深部灰质矿化与实质疾病负担和萎缩的增加有关。这些发现可能代表了疾病慢性的影像学标志,并为传统 MRI 提供了补充信息,特别是在 麻疹 流行地区慢性脑炎的评估中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为传统 MRI 提供了补充信息,特别是在评估 麻疹 流行地区的慢性脑炎方面。它们可能为开发更准确的基于成像的 SSPE 诊断和分期工具提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,基于单中心 队列研究,这可能会限制普遍性。由于该研究的观察性质和对半定量视觉分级系统的依赖,证据是中等的。

title_zh: 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 中的磁敏感加权成像结果:皮层下顺磁边缘和深部灰质变化。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder caused by persistent measles virus infection. Conventional MRI plays a key role in diagnosis and staging; however, susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI) findings in SSPE have not been systematically characterized, particularly with respect to their relationship to disease burden and neurodegeneration. With this study we aim to evaluate SWI changes in SSPE, with emphasis on the Subcortical Paramagnetic Rim (SPR) and deep gray matter mineralization, and to assess their association with parenchymal disease burden and cerebral atrophy. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 126 patients with confirmed SSPE who underwent MRI including SWI. T2/FLAIR hyperintensities were assessed across predefined supratentorial and infratentorial parenchymal regions. A composite total parenchymal disease burden score was calculated. Cerebral atrophy and deep gray matter mineralization were evaluated using semi-quantitative visual grading systems. SWI was also assessed for the presence of a SPR. Associations between susceptibility findings, parenchymal disease burden, cerebral atrophy, and clinical parameters were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods. RESULTS: SPR was identified in 14 of 128 MRI studies (10.9%), most commonly involving the parietal lobes. Patients with the rim had significantly longer symptom duration, higher disease stage, greater parenchymal disease burden, higher atrophy scores, and higher deep gray matter mineralization scores compared with patients without the rim (p < 0.01). Deep gray matter mineralization scores showed significant positive correlations with both global parenchymal disease burden and cerebral atrophy (Spearman's ρ, p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: SPR and deep gray matter mineralization, are associated with increasing parenchymal disease burden and atrophy. These findings likely represent imaging markers of disease chronicity and provide complementary information to conventional MRI, particularly in the evaluation of chronic encephalitis in measles-endemic regions.
abstract_zh: 背景:亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE) 是一种由持续 麻疹病毒 感染引起的进行性神经退行性疾病。常规MRI在诊断和分期中起着关键作用;然而,SSPE 的磁敏加权成像 (SWI) 结果尚未得到系统表征,特别是其与疾病负担和神经退行性变的关系。通过这项研究,我们旨在评估 SSPE 中的 SWI 变化,重点关注皮质下顺磁环 (SPR) 和深部灰质矿化,并评估它们与实质疾病负担和脑萎缩的关系。方法:这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了 126 名确诊为 SSPE 的患者,这些患者接受了 MRI(包括 SWI)检查。在预先确定的幕上和幕下实质区域评估 T2/FLAIR 高信号。计算综合总实质疾病负担评分。使用半定量视觉分级系统评估脑萎缩和深层灰质矿化。还评估了 SWI 是否存在 SPR。使用非参数统计方法分析了敏感性结果、实质疾病负担、脑萎缩和临床参数之间的关联。结果:128 项 MRI 研究中有 14 项(10.9%)发现了 SPR,最常见的是顶叶。与无边缘患者相比,有边缘患者的症状持续时间明显更长、疾病分期更高、实质疾病负担更大、萎缩评分更高、深部灰质矿化评分更高(p < 0.01)。深部灰质矿化评分与整体实质疾病负担和脑萎缩呈显着正相关(Spearman's ρ,p < 0.001)。结论:SPR 和深部灰质矿化与实质疾病负担的增加和萎缩有关。这些发现可能代表了疾病慢性的影像学标志,并为传统 MRI 提供了补充信息,特别是在 麻疹 流行地区慢性脑炎的评估中。

title: Clinical consultation: The role of vitamin A in the management of confirmed acute measles infection.
abstract: Abstract Purpose Although measles was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000, the rate of measles infection in 2026 is the highest in more than 3 decades. This clinical consultation explores the role of vitamin A in the treatment of acute measles infection and the challenges posed with this treatment in pediatric patients due to the limitations in currently available formulations. Summary The role of vitamin A in the treatment of acute, confirmed measles infection has been well established and is recommended by major medical organizations, including the World Health Organization and American Academy of Pediatrics. Despite the benefits that vitamin A has demonstrated in past studies, treatment with vitamin A remains difficult due to challenges in administration secondary to the limited formulations currently available in the United States. Multiple options exist to extract liquid vitamin A from capsules, but these methods are cumbersome and possess significant challenges. Conclusion Vitamin A treatment should be used in patients with acute, confirmed measles infection, after confirming that they are not at risk for drug interactions and have no symptoms of vitamin A toxicity if they were previously treated with vitamin A. A concentrated liquid formulation of vitamin A approved by the US Food and Drug Administration is needed to overcome current obstacles with administration of vitamin A in pediatric patients unable to swallow capsules.

Multiple options exist to extract liquid vitamin A from capsules, but these methods are cumbersome and possess significant challenges. Conclusion Vitamin A treatment should be used in patients with acute, confirmed measles infection, after confirming that they are not at risk for drug interactions and have no symptoms of vitamin A toxicity if they were previously treated with vitamin A. A concentrated liquid formulation of vitamin A approved by the US Food and Drug Administration is needed to overcome current obstacles with administration of vitamin A in pediatric patients unable to swallow capsules.

source_body_en: Abstract Purpose Although measles was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000, the rate of measles infection in 2026 is the highest in more than 3 decades. This clinical consultation explores the role of vitamin A in the treatment of acute measles infection and the challenges posed with this treatment in pediatric patients due to the limitations in currently available formulations. Summary The role of vitamin A in the treatment of acute, confirmed measles infection has been well established and is recommended by major medical organizations, including the World Health Organization and American Academy of Pediatrics. Despite the benefits that vitamin A has demonstrated in past studies, treatment with vitamin A remains difficult due to challenges in administration secondary to the limited formulations currently available in the United States. Multiple options exist to extract liquid vitamin A from capsules, but these methods are cumbersome and possess significant challenges. Conclusion Vitamin A treatment should be used in patients with acute, confirmed measles infection, after confirming that they are not at risk for drug interactions and have no symptoms of vitamin A toxicity if they were previously treated with vitamin A. A concentrated liquid formulation of vitamin A approved by the US Food and Drug Administration is needed to overcome current obstacles with administration of vitamin A in pediatric patients unable to swallow capsules.
abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 虽然 麻疹 在 2000 年就在美国被宣布消灭,但 2026 年 麻疹 感染率是 3 多年来最高的。本次临床咨询探讨了维生素 A 在急性 麻疹 感染的 治疗 中的作用,以及由于目前可用制剂的局限性,该 治疗 对儿科患者带来的挑战。摘要 维生素 A 在急性确诊 麻疹 感染中的作用已得到充分证实,并得到世界卫生组织和美国儿科学会等主要医疗组织的推荐。尽管维生素 A 在过去的研究中已经证明了其益处,但由于美国目前可用的配方有限,在给药方面存在挑战,含有维生素 A 的 治疗 仍然很困难。从胶囊中提取液体维生素 A 的方法有多种,但这些方法都很麻烦且面临重大挑战。结论 对于急性、确诊的 麻疹 感染患者,应使用维生素 A 麻疹,并确认他们没有药物相互作用的风险,并且如果之前接受过维生素 A 治疗,也没有维生素 A 毒性症状。需要美国食品和药物管理局批准的维生素 A 浓缩液体制剂来克服目前无法吞咽胶囊的儿科患者服用维生素 A 的障碍。

title: Evaluation of a dual-intensity measles surveillance system in conflict-affected Borno State, Nigeria.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Maintaining measles surveillance in fragile, conflict-affected settings remains challenging due to insecurity, limited laboratory access and epidemic surges. Borno State, Nigeria, operates a dual-intensity surveillance framework combining laboratory-confirmed case-based surveillance (CBS-Lab) with epidemiologically linked outbreak reporting (CBS-Epi). We evaluated system performance, spatiotemporal surveillance patterns and operational constraints from 2020 to 2024. METHODS: We conducted a programmatic surveillance system evaluation using the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention updated guidelines, assessing system attributes against WHO AFRO benchmarks. The evaluation used retrospective measles surveillance data (28 370 suspected cases) and a cross-sectional survey of surveillance officers assessing perceptual and operational domains (31/58; 53% response), supplemented by a contextual policy document review. Spatiotemporal alignment between surveillance streams was analysed using Spearman's rank correlation. RESULTS: CBS-Lab represented 6.1% (n=1725) of notifications, functioning as a sentinel subset with ≥98% completeness, a 47.8% positive predictive value and 88.4% specimen collection within 48 hours, though only 5% of cases met the <10-day turnaround standard.CBS-Epi (93.9%; n=26 645) maintained ≥99.8% completeness and captured epidemic peaks in 2021 and 2023, though representativeness was constrained by geographic inaccessibility in conflict-affected local government areas. No case-record overlap occurred between streams due to protocol design. Aggregate temporal (ρ=0.69) and geographic (ρ=0.65) co-variations were strong (p<0.001). Laboratory sampling intensity was inversely correlated with district case burden (ρ=-0.64; p<0.001), indicating risk-based prioritisation. Acceptability remained high despite insecurity, transport and funding constraints. CONCLUSION: Within the specific operational context of Borno State, dual-intensity surveillance enabled operationally useful epidemic intelligence and maintained mortality-reduction phase performance despite protracted conflict. These findings suggest that the pragmatic combination of simplified outbreak reporting and targeted laboratory confirmation may represent a feasible surveillance approach in comparable fragile settings, though contextual adaptation would be required.

abstract_zh: 简介:由于不安全、实验室准入有限和流行病激增,在脆弱、受冲突影响的环境中维持 麻疹 监测 仍然具有挑战性。尼日利亚博尔诺州运行双强度 监测 框架,将基于实验室确诊病例的 监测 (CBS-Lab) 与流行病学相关的 暴发 报告 (CBS-Epi) 相结合。我们评估了 2020 年至 2024 年的系统性能、时空 监测 模式和操作限制。方法:我们使用美国疾病控制和预防中心更新的指南进行了程序化 监测 系统评估,根据 WHO AFRO 基准评估系统属性。该评估使用了回顾性 麻疹 监测 数据(28 370 例疑似病例)和对 麻疹 官员评估感知和操作领域的横断面调查(31/58;53% 的回应),并辅以背景政策文件审查。使用 Spearman 等级相关性分析 监测 流之间的时空对齐。结果:CBS-Lab 占通知的 6.1% (n=1725),作为哨兵子集,完整性≥98%,阳性预测值 47.8%,48 小时内收集到 88.4% 的样本,但只有 5% 的病例达到 <10 天的周转标准。CBS-Epi (93.9%;n=26 645) 保持 ≥99.8% 的完整性,尽管代表性受到受冲突影响地方政府地区交通不便的限制,但在 2021 年和 2023 年达到了流行病高峰。由于协议设计,流之间没有发生病例记录重叠。总体时间 (ρ=0.69) 和地理 (ρ=0.65) 协变很强 (p<0.001)。实验室采样强度与地区病例负担呈负相关(ρ=-0.64;p<0.001),表明基于风险的优先顺序。尽管不安全、交通和资金有限,但可接受性仍然很高。结论:在博尔诺州的具体运作背景下,双强度 死亡率 实现了可操作的有用的流行病情报,并在长期冲突的情况下保持了 死亡率 减少阶段的表现。这些发现表明,简化的 暴发 报告和有针对性的实验室确认的务实结合可能代表了在相当脆弱的环境中可行的 监测 方法,尽管需要根据具体情况进行调整。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the clinical management of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) in adults, highlighting the challenges in diagnosing and treating this rare complication of measles virus infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a case report detailing the management of a single adult patient with SSPE, diagnosed and treated as PRES (Progressive Rubella Encephalopathy Syndrome) due to diagnostic challenges.
analysis.methods: The methods involved clinical evaluation, neurological assessment, and molecular testing to confirm the diagnosis of SSPE, with the patient's clinical data and treatment approach being the primary focus.
analysis.main_results: The patient presented with progressive neurological symptoms and was managed as PRES, but the final diagnosis confirmed it as SSPE caused by measles virus infection.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the case as highlighting the diagnostic difficulties in distinguishing SSPE from PRES, emphasizing the need for careful clinical and molecular evaluation to ensure accurate management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of accurate diagnosis in managing SSPE, which has significant implications for clinical practice and public health surveillance in measles virus-endemic regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-case design, which may not be generalizable. However, the evidence is strong given the detailed clinical and molecular analysis provided.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes an adult patient with subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) who was initially managed as PRES (Progressive Rubella Encephalopathy Syndrome) due to diagnostic challenges. The study highlights the importance of accurate clinical and molecular evaluation in distinguishing SSPE from PRES, which is critical for appropriate management. The findings emphasize the need for vigilance in diagnosing rare complications of measles virus infection, particularly in adults. The study's limitations include its single-case design, which restricts generalizability, but the evidence is considered strong due to the thorough analysis of the patient's clinical data and molecular confirmation of the measles virus as the causative agent. The case contributes to the understanding of SSPE and its differential diagnosis, offering insights for improved clinical practice and public health surveillance.

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

title: Knowledge, Attitudes, Practices and Determinants of Measles Vaccination among Mothers of Under-Five Children in Agege Local Government Area, Lagos State, Nigeria
abstract: Background: Measles remains an important vaccine-preventable cause of childhood morbidity and mortality where vaccination is delayed or incomplete. This study assessed maternal knowledge and attitudes, measles vaccination uptake, and determinants of uptake among mothers of under-five children in Agege Local Government Area (LGA), Lagos State, Nigeria. Methods: A facility-based descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 308 mothers of under-five children selected through a multistage sampling procedure. Data were collected with a structured interviewer-administered questionnaire and analysed using JASP version 0.98.1. Descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, Cramer's V, odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals (CIs), and multivariable logistic regression were used; statistical significance was set at p < .05. Results: Mean maternal age was 33.7 ± 8.5 years. Good knowledge was recorded in 267 (87%) respondents and 303 (98%) had a positive attitude. Overall measles vaccination uptake was adequate among 282 (92%), although 97 (32%) reported a missed vaccination appointment and 112 (36.4%) reported incomplete scheduled immunization. Knowledge was associated with uptake (χ2 = 15.57, p < .001), whereas attitude was not (χ2 = 0.469, p = .494). In the adjusted model, occupation, number of under-five children, knowledge status, waiting time, work schedule, information gaps, cultural beliefs, family-elder influence, religious beliefs and community norms were statistically significant (p < .05); several estimates had very wide CIs and therefore require cautious interpretation. Conclusion: Maternal knowledge, attitudes and reported measles vaccination uptake were high, but missed appointments, incomplete immunization and practical, informational and sociocultural barriers persisted. Programmes should combine accurate health education with shorter waiting times, flexible service delivery, defaulter tracking and family/community engagement.
journal: International Journal of Global Health and Epidemiology

abstract_original: Background: Measles remains an important vaccine-preventable cause of childhood morbidity and mortality where vaccination is delayed or incomplete. This study assessed maternal knowledge and attitudes, measles vaccination uptake, and determinants of uptake among mothers of under-five children in Agege Local Government Area (LGA), Lagos State, Nigeria. Methods: A facility-based descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 308 mothers of under-five children selected through a multistage sampling procedure. Data were collected with a structured interviewer-administered questionnaire and analysed using JASP version 0.98.1. Descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, Cramer's V, odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals (CIs), and multivariable logistic regression were used; statistical significance was set at p < .05. Results: Mean maternal age was 33.7 ± 8.5 years. Good knowledge was recorded in 267 (87%) respondents and 303 (98%) had a positive attitude. Overall measles vaccination uptake was adequate among 282 (92%), although 97 (32%) reported a missed vaccination appointment and 112 (36.4%) reported incomplete scheduled immunization. Knowledge was associated with uptake (χ2 = 15.57, p < .001), whereas attitude was not (χ2 = 0.469, p = .494). In the adjusted model, occupation, number of under-five children, knowledge status, waiting time, work schedule, information gaps, cultural beliefs, family-elder influence, religious beliefs and community norms were statistically significant (p < .05); several estimates had very wide CIs and therefore require cautious interpretation. Conclusion: Maternal knowledge, attitudes and reported measles vaccination uptake were high, but missed appointments, incomplete immunization and practical, informational and sociocultural barriers persisted. Programmes should combine accurate health education with shorter waiting times, flexible service delivery, defaulter tracking and family/community engagement.

abstract_zh: 背景:麻疹 仍然是儿童发病的重要 疫苗 可预防原因,而 死亡率 则 疫苗接种 延迟或不完整。本研究评估了尼日利亚拉各斯州阿杰地方政府区 (LGA) 5 岁以下儿童母亲的母亲知识和态度、麻疹 麻疹 的吸收情况以及吸收的决定因素。方法:对通过多阶段抽样程序选出的 308 名 5 岁以下儿童的母亲进行了一项基于机构的描述性横断面研究。通过结构化访谈问卷收集数据,并使用 JASP 0.98.1 版本进行分析。使用描述性统计、卡方检验、Cramer V、95% 置信区间 (CI) 的比值比以及多变量逻辑回归;统计显着性设置为 p < .05。结果:产妇平均年龄为 33.7 ± 8.5 岁。267 名(87%)受访者记录了良好的知识,303 名(98%)受访者持积极态度。尽管 97 人 (32%) 报告错过了 麻疹 疫苗接种 预约,112 人 (36.4%) 报告计划免疫接种不完整,但 282 人 (92%) 的总体 麻疹 疫苗接种 吸收率充足。知识与吸收相关(χ2 = 15.57,p < .001),而态度则不然(χ2 = 0.469,p = .494)。在调整后的模型中,职业、五岁以下儿童数量、知识状况、等待时间、工作时间表、信息差距、文化信仰、家庭长辈影响、宗教信仰和社区规范具有统计显着性(p < .05);一些估计值的置信区间非常宽,因此需要谨慎解释。结论:母亲的知识、态度和报告的 麻疹 疫苗接种 吸收率很高,但错过预约、免疫不完全以及实际、信息和社会文化障碍仍然存在。计划应将准确的健康教育与更短的等待时间、灵活的服务提供、违约者跟踪和家庭/社区参与结合起来。

title: Beyond the first dose: socioeconomic inequality in pentavalent and measles vaccine dropout among Nigerian children, evidence from the 2023–24 Demographic and Health Survey
abstract: Abstract Background Few countries have as many under-immunised children as Nigeria. Catch-up programmes rightly prioritise zero-dose children, but children who begin the schedule and then fall away form a large, readily traceable group whose distribution is poorly understood. We estimated dropout from the first to the third dose of pentavalent vaccine (Penta1–Penta3) and from the first to the second dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1–MCV2), measured wealth-related inequality in each, and identified the factors that account for it. Methods From the children's file of the 2023–24 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey, we drew two samples: 3,164 Penta1 recipients aged 12–23 months and 2,314 MCV1 recipients aged 24–35 months. We estimated design-adjusted prevalences, measured inequality with the Erreygers corrected concentration index, identified correlates with survey-weighted logistic regression, and apportioned inequality among them by regression-based decomposition. Results Coverage reached 53.8% for Penta3 and 30.5% for MCV2. Of children who started each series, 14.5% did not complete pentavalent vaccination and 36.6% did not receive MCV2. Penta dropout was 17% in the poorest and 8% in the richest quintile; for measles the figures were 46% and 31%. Dropout was concentrated among poorer children (Erreygers index − 0.083 for Penta and − 0.105 for MCV), but much less strongly than first-dose coverage was concentrated among richer children (Penta1 + 0.422). Penta dropout odds were lower in the richest households (aOR 0.37, 95% CI 0.21–0.66) and with higher maternal education (aOR 0.40, 0.23–0.71), and higher for urban children once wealth was considered (aOR 2.35, 1.70–3.26). Wealth and maternal education contributed most to inequality in both outcomes, and place of delivery contributed substantially for MCV. Conclusions Most of the wealth-related inequity in Nigeria's immunisation programme arises when children enter the schedule, but it does not disappear after first contact and is greater in the second year of life. Services should trace defaulters, strengthen the second-year-of-life contact and target the urban poor, children of less-educated mothers and children born at home.

elements_zh.methods: 研究人员估计了设计调整后的 患病率,用 Erreygers 校正集中指数测量了不平等,确定了与调查加权逻辑回归的相关性,并通过基于回归的分解在它们之间分配了不平等。
elements_zh.main_results: Penta3 的覆盖率达到 53.8%,MCV2 的覆盖率达到 30.5%。在开始每个系列的儿童中,14.5% 没有完成五价 疫苗接种,36.6% 没有接受 MCV2。最贫困人口的 Penta 辍学率为 17%,最富有的五分之一人口的辍学率为 8%;麻疹 的数字分别为 46% 和 31%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,财富和母亲教育是造成这两种结果不平等的最重要因素,而分娩地点对 MCV 的影响很大。研究结果表明,服务应追踪违约者,加强与二年级孩子的联系,并针对城市贫民、母亲受教育程度较低的孩子以及在家出生的孩子。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为 监测、诊断 和 治疗 策略提供信息,以提高 疫苗接种 覆盖率并减少免疫规划中的社会经济不平等。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性包括使用自我报告的数据和潜在的回忆偏差。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

title: Measles resurgence in England: challenges in maintaining elimination, 2023 to 2024
abstract: BACKGROUND Between October 2023 and September 2024, England experienced the largest measles outbreak in decades. AIM We describe the epidemiology of the outbreak, burden on secondary care services and the factors that led to this resurgence. METHODS The UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) conducts enhanced surveillance of all suspected measles cases in England. A measles line list was established using routinely collected notification, laboratory, demographic and vaccination information. Laboratory-confirmed cases were defined using serology and PCR. Incidence rates were calculated using mid-2024 population estimates. Severity was assessed through linkage with emergency department attendances, hospital admissions and length of stay. RESULTS Most of the 2,821 laboratory-confirmed cases resided in London (n = 1,283; 45.5%) and in the West Midlands (n = 710; 25.2%). Incidence was highest in London (14.1/100,000 population). Children under 10 years represented 58.6% (n = 1,653) of cases. Most cases (n = 2,609; 92.5%) were not vaccinated, and 63.0% (n = 1,776) lived in areas belonging to the two most deprived quintiles. Of the 2,788 cases that could be linked to hospitalisation data, 76.3% (n = 2,127) attended emergency care and 38.2% (n = 1,066) were admitted. Median length of stay was 2.0 days, seven cases received intensive care; one death was reported. Admissions were highest among infants aged CONCLUSION This outbreak reflects a shift towards endemic measles transmission in areas of high deprivation and low vaccine uptake in England. It underscores the importance of achieving 95% uptake with measles vaccine in all areas and communities to achieve and maintain elimination.

title: Measles resurgence in Italy: analysis of temporal patterns of viral transmission, surveillance performance, and vaccination coverage at national and regional levels, October 2023 to March 2025
abstract: BACKGROUND Following substantial progress towards measles elimination after the COVID-19 pandemic, Italy experienced a marked increase in measles cases in 2024. AIM Our aim was to describe measles epidemiology in Italy, October 2023–March 2025, and assess vaccination coverage, surveillance performance at national and regional levels, and temporal patterns of transmission. METHODS Numbers of measles cases and outbreaks were reviewed. Vaccination coverage and surveillance indicators were described at national and regional levels. Measles variants were classified by genotype and Distinct Sequence Identifier (DSId). Temporal transmission patterns of measles variants were assessed nationally and regionally to identify sustained transmission chains (≥ 12 consecutive months). RESULTS In total, 1,311 measles cases were reported, with 178 outbreaks. Cases’ median age was 30.9 years (IQR: 15.6–39.8); 601 were female (45.8%) and 710 male (54.2%). Only 3.1% (38/1,230) were fully vaccinated. In 2024, the first-dose vaccination coverage increased to 94.77% (95% CI: 94.70–94.84%) nationally, while second-dose coverage declined to 84.45% (95% CI: 84.35–84.55%). Among all cases, 12.1% (n = 158) were imported/importation-related, 64.1% (n = 841) were of unknown origin and 52.8% had DSId data available (n = 692), with high regional heterogeneity. Twenty-five measles variants were identified. One variant (D8–5963) showed sustained national transmission for over 12 months, meeting criteria for re-established endemic transmission, although no single region showed uninterrupted ≥ 12-month circulation. CONCLUSION Measles resurgence in Italy was marked by persistent immunity gaps, heterogeneous surveillance performance, and sustained national circulation of a D8 variant, indicating loss of near-elimination status. Strengthening vaccination strategies and enhancing molecular surveillance is urgently needed to restore progress towards measles elimination.

title_zh: 麻疹 在意大利卷土重来:2023 年 10 月至 2025 年 3 月期间病毒 传播、监测 表现以及 疫苗接种 在国家和地区层面覆盖的时间模式分析
source_body_en: BACKGROUND Following substantial progress towards measles elimination after the COVID-19 pandemic, Italy experienced a marked increase in measles cases in 2024. AIM Our aim was to describe measles epidemiology in Italy, October 2023–March 2025, and assess vaccination coverage, surveillance performance at national and regional levels, and temporal patterns of transmission. METHODS Numbers of measles cases and outbreaks were reviewed. Vaccination coverage and surveillance indicators were described at national and regional levels. Measles variants were classified by genotype and Distinct Sequence Identifier (DSId). Temporal transmission patterns of measles variants were assessed nationally and regionally to identify sustained transmission chains (≥ 12 consecutive months). RESULTS In total, 1,311 measles cases were reported, with 178 outbreaks. Cases’ median age was 30.9 years (IQR: 15.6–39.8); 601 were female (45.8%) and 710 male (54.2%). Only 3.1% (38/1,230) were fully vaccinated. In 2024, the first-dose vaccination coverage increased to 94.77% (95% CI: 94.70–94.84%) nationally, while second-dose coverage declined to 84.45% (95% CI: 84.35–84.55%). Among all cases, 12.1% (n = 158) were imported/importation-related, 64.1% (n = 841) were of unknown origin and 52.8% had DSId data available (n = 692), with high regional heterogeneity. Twenty-five measles variants were identified. One variant (D8–5963) showed sustained national transmission for over 12 months, meeting criteria for re-established endemic transmission, although no single region showed uninterrupted ≥ 12-month circulation. CONCLUSION Measles resurgence in Italy was marked by persistent immunity gaps, heterogeneous surveillance performance, and sustained national circulation of a D8 variant, indicating loss of near-elimination status. Strengthening vaccination strategies and enhancing molecular surveillance is urgently needed to restore progress towards measles elimination.

title: MEASLES-INDUCED SUBACUTE SCLEROSING PANENCEPHALITIS (DAWSON'S DISEASE): CLINICAL CHARACTERISTICS AND DIAGNOSTICS
abstract: Introduction: Measles is characterized by high contagiousness. One of its rarest but most lethal complications is subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), which primarily occurs in children and adolescents. The frequency among infected individuals is 1:10,000, while in vaccinated individuals, it is exceptionally rare (~1:500,000). Pathogenesis and Course: The main feature of the disease is an atypically long, 6–15-year asymptomatic period between the contracted measles infection and the onset of panencephalitis. The persistence of the virus in neural tissues and the disruption of the immune response lead to progressively worsening psychoneurological damage. The clinical course includes 4 stages: behavioral changes and headaches, seizures, severe movement coordination disorders (ataxia, myoclonus), and coma caused by brainstem damage, leading to a fatal outcome (on average within 3 years). Diagnostics: The diagnosis is based on the medical history, characteristic Radermecker complexes on the electroencephalogram (EEG), a sharply elevated titer of measles-specific IgG antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid and blood, and demyelination revealed by MRI. Conclusion: Panencephalitis represents the most severe complication of measles. Despite modern diagnostic methods, the disease is progressive and fatal, with universal vaccination remaining its only effective prevention measure.

title_zh: 麻疹 诱发的 亚急性硬化性全脑炎(道森病):临床特征和诊断
source_body_en: Introduction: Measles is characterized by high contagiousness. One of its rarest but most lethal complications is subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), which primarily occurs in children and adolescents. The frequency among infected individuals is 1:10,000, while in vaccinated individuals, it is exceptionally rare (~1:500,000). Pathogenesis and Course: The main feature of the disease is an atypically long, 6–15-year asymptomatic period between the contracted measles infection and the onset of panencephalitis. The persistence of the virus in neural tissues and the disruption of the immune response lead to progressively worsening psychoneurological damage. The clinical course includes 4 stages: behavioral changes and headaches, seizures, severe movement coordination disorders (ataxia, myoclonus), and coma caused by brainstem damage, leading to a fatal outcome (on average within 3 years). Diagnostics: The diagnosis is based on the medical history, characteristic Radermecker complexes on the electroencephalogram (EEG), a sharply elevated titer of measles-specific IgG antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid and blood, and demyelination revealed by MRI. Conclusion: Panencephalitis represents the most severe complication of measles. Despite modern diagnostic methods, the disease is progressive and fatal, with universal vaccination remaining its only effective prevention measure.

title: Measles Vaccination Coverage and Vaccine Exemptions Before Ontario’s 2024–2025 Outbreak: An Analysis of Case Rates Across Public Health Units
abstract: Time-stamped analysis plan for an exploratory ecological study of measles vaccination coverage, vaccine exemptions and outbreak case rates across Ontario’s 29 public health units during the 2024–2025 measles outbreak. The study uses publicly available aggregate data from Public Health Ontario (outbreak cases by public health unit; school-based measles coverage and exemption estimates for 7- and 17-year-olds) and Statistics Canada (population estimates). The plan was lodged before any statistical modelling. Public health unit exposure values and outbreak case rates had already been inspected, which prompted the documented amendment in version 2 (removal of the primary/secondary exposure hierarchy and addition of data-quality caveats). This is therefore not a fully prospective preregistration, and all association analyses are exploratory.

title: Comparative Modeling of Measles Incidences Among Children Below Five Years in Rivers State, Nigeria Using the Holt-Winters, SARIMA, and Hybrid SARIMA-ANN Models
abstract: This research analyzed various time-series forecasting models for measles occurrences in children younger than five in Rivers State, Nigeria, utilizing monthly data sourced from the Rivers State Hospital Management Board and allied partners spanning from January 2015 to December 2024. Python 3.11 software was used for the data analysis. The investigation focused on the temporal patterns of measles cases and assessed the prediction efficacy of additive Holt–Winters, multiplicative Holt–Winters, Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA), and hybrid SARIMA–Artificial Neural Network (ANN) models. To explore the data series, methods such as descriptive statistics, seasonal decomposition, the Jarque–Bera normality examination, the Augmented Dickey–Fuller unit-root evaluation, autocorrelation assessment, and the Ljung–Box test were utilized. The forecasting efficiency was measured via root mean squared error (RMSE), mean absolute scaled error (MASE), and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). Findings indicated an average of 26.17 monthly cases of measles, with a standard deviation of 21.43 and a peak of 124 cases. The data series displayed positive skewness and did not conform to a normal distribution, while the results from the Augmented Dickey–Fuller test suggested stationarity at level significance (p < 0.001). The Ljung–Box analysis uncovered significant serial correlations at lags 12 and 20 (p < 0.001). Out of the four forecasting techniques, the multiplicative Holt–Winters method yielded the best results, achieving the lowest RMSE at 16.43 and a reported MASE of 86.68. Conversely, the hybrid SARIMA–ANN approach was the least effective, presenting an RMSE of 22.05 and a reported MASE of 261.66. The study concludes that the multiplicative Holt–Winters method stands out as the most effective model among those tested. It suggests the validation of the reported MASE values, the importance of consistent out-of-sample evaluation, and enhancing regular measles monitoring to aid in timely forecasting, vaccination strategy, and focused public health actions.

title_zh: 使用 Holt-Winters、SARIMA 和混合 SARIMA-ANN 模型对尼日利亚河流州五岁以下儿童的 麻疹 发病率 进行比较建模
source_body_en: This research analyzed various time-series forecasting models for measles occurrences in children younger than five in Rivers State, Nigeria, utilizing monthly data sourced from the Rivers State Hospital Management Board and allied partners spanning from January 2015 to December 2024. Python 3.11 software was used for the data analysis. The investigation focused on the temporal patterns of measles cases and assessed the prediction efficacy of additive Holt–Winters, multiplicative Holt–Winters, Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA), and hybrid SARIMA–Artificial Neural Network (ANN) models. To explore the data series, methods such as descriptive statistics, seasonal decomposition, the Jarque–Bera normality examination, the Augmented Dickey–Fuller unit-root evaluation, autocorrelation assessment, and the Ljung–Box test were utilized. The forecasting efficiency was measured via root mean squared error (RMSE), mean absolute scaled error (MASE), and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). Findings indicated an average of 26.17 monthly cases of measles, with a standard deviation of 21.43 and a peak of 124 cases. The data series displayed positive skewness and did not conform to a normal distribution, while the results from the Augmented Dickey–Fuller test suggested stationarity at level significance (p < 0.001). The Ljung–Box analysis uncovered significant serial correlations at lags 12 and 20 (p < 0.001). Out of the four forecasting techniques, the multiplicative Holt–Winters method yielded the best results, achieving the lowest RMSE at 16.43 and a reported MASE of 86.68. Conversely, the hybrid SARIMA–ANN approach was the least effective, presenting an RMSE of 22.05 and a reported MASE of 261.66. The study concludes that the multiplicative Holt–Winters method stands out as the most effective model among those tested. It suggests the validation of the reported MASE values, the importance of consistent out-of-sample evaluation, and enhancing regular measles monitoring to aid in timely forecasting, vaccination strategy, and focused public health actions.

title: The effect of age at first dose of a measles-containing vaccine on measles humoral immunity: a retrospective cohort study, Canada, 2014 to 2016
abstract: BACKGROUND Canada eliminated measles in 1998; however, large outbreaks have been recently reported, and elimination status was lost in 2025. AIM We aimed to estimate the effect of age at first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) on measles IgG concentration and seronegativity among two-dose recipients nearly two decades after vaccination. METHODS We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 10,766 twice-vaccinated individuals tested for measles IgG from 2014 to 2016 in Ontario, Canada. We predicted measles IgG concentration and seronegativity using thresholds of RESULTS A 1-month increase in age at MCV1 (between 12 and 15 months) was associated with 13.7% (95% confidence interval (CI): 7.1–20.8) higher predicted mean measles IgG concentration for females born after elimination and 9.2% (95% CI: 6.8–11.6) for females born before elimination. Depending on the seronegativity threshold and the measles elimination status at birth, a 1-month increase in age at MCV1 (between 12 and 15 months) was associated with lower odds ratio of seronegativity ranging from 0.74 (95% CI: 0.63–0.85) to 0.87 (95% CI: 0.57–1.27). Using the lowest threshold (≤ 120 mIU/mL) and the longest follow-up period (24 years post-MCV1), we predicted that 4.1% (95% CI: 2.7–6.1) of females vaccinated with MCV1 at 15 months of age would be seronegative, compared with 9.6% (95% CI: 7.4–12.3) of those vaccinated at 12 months. DISCUSSION Delaying MCV1 to older ages (13–15 months) may result in an absolute decrease as large as 6% in the percentage of seronegative individuals, potentially increasing the likelihood of maintaining herd immunity.

source_body_en: BACKGROUND Canada eliminated measles in 1998; however, large outbreaks have been recently reported, and elimination status was lost in 2025. AIM We aimed to estimate the effect of age at first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) on measles IgG concentration and seronegativity among two-dose recipients nearly two decades after vaccination. METHODS We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 10,766 twice-vaccinated individuals tested for measles IgG from 2014 to 2016 in Ontario, Canada. We predicted measles IgG concentration and seronegativity using thresholds of RESULTS A 1-month increase in age at MCV1 (between 12 and 15 months) was associated with 13.7% (95% confidence interval (CI): 7.1–20.8) higher predicted mean measles IgG concentration for females born after elimination and 9.2% (95% CI: 6.8–11.6) for females born before elimination. title: IMPACTO DA IMUNIZAÇÃO NA ERRADICAÇÃO DO SARAMPO E A INCIDÊNCIA DE SURTOS EPIDEMIOLÓGICOS NO BRASIL EM 2025 THE IMPACT OF IMMUNIZATION ON MEASLES ERADICATION AND THE INCIDENCE OF EPIDEMIOLOGICAL OUTBREAKS IN BRAZIL IN 2025 EL IMPACTO DE LA INMUNIZACIÓN EN LA ERRADICACIÓN DEL SARAMPIÓN Y LA INCIDENCIA DE BROTES EPIDEMIOLÓGICOS EN BRASIL EN 2025
abstract: Este artigo buscou analisar o impacto da imunização no controle e na eliminação do sarampo, relacionando a cobertura vacinal à incidência de surtos epidemiológicos no Brasil, com ênfase no cenário observado em 2025. Trata-se de um estudo epidemiológico descritivo, retrospectivo e de abordagem quantitativa, fundamentado em dados secundários provenientes de sistemas oficiais de vigilância em saúde e imunização, considerando registros do período de 2020 a 2025. Foram analisadas informações referentes aos casos confirmados, cobertura vacinal, distribuição temporal e ocorrência de surtos, com destaque para o estado do Tocantins. Os dados demonstraram redução expressiva dos casos após 2021, ausência de confirmações em 2023 e posterior ocorrência de novos registros em 2024 e 2025. Em 2025, destacou-se o surto ocorrido no município de Campos Lindos, no Tocantins, associado à introdução do vírus após viagem internacional e à presença de indivíduos suscetíveis. Os achados reforçam que a vacinação constitui a principal estratégia para interromper a transmissão do sarampo. Conclui-se que a manutenção de elevada e homogênea cobertura vacinal, associada à vigilância epidemiológica contínua, é indispensável para prevenir novos surtos e sustentar a eliminação da doença no Brasil.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This article sought to analyze the impact of immunization on measles control and eradication, linking vaccination coverage to the incidence of epidemiological outbreaks in Brazil, with a focus on the 2025 scenario.
analysis.study_design_and_population: It was an epidemiological descriptive, retrospective, and quantitative study based on secondary data from official health and immunization surveillance systems, covering the period from 2020 to 2025.
analysis.methods: Data analysis included information on confirmed cases, vaccination coverage, temporal distribution, and outbreak occurrence, with emphasis on the state of Tocantins.
analysis.main_results: Data showed a significant reduction in cases after 2021, no confirmations in 2023, and subsequent new registrations in 2024 and 2025.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: In 2025, a surge in Campos Lindos, Tocantins, was highlighted, associated with international travel and the presence of susceptible individuals.

title_zh: 2025 年巴西流行病学疫苗接种对 麻疹 根除和 发病率 流行病学 麻疹 的影响2025 年巴西免疫接种影响和萨拉皮翁根除及布罗特斯流行病事件的影响 EN 2025
source_body_en: Este artigo buscou analisar o impacto da imunização no controle e na eliminação do sarampo, relacionando a cobertura vacinal à incidência de surtos epidemiológicos no Brasil, com ênfase no cenário observado em 2025. Trata-se de um estudo epidemiológico descritivo, retrospectivo e de abordagem quantitativa, fundamentado em dados secundários provenientes de sistemas oficiais de vigilância em saúde e imunização, considerando registros do período de 2020 a 2025. Foram analisadas informações referentes aos casos confirmados, cobertura vacinal, distribuição temporal e ocorrência de surtos, com destaque para o estado do Tocantins. Os dados demonstraram redução expressiva dos casos após 2021, ausência de confirmações em 2023 e posterior ocorrência de novos registros em 2024 e 2025. Em 2025, destacou-se o surto ocorrido no município de Campos Lindos, no Tocantins, associado à introdução do vírus após viagem internacional e à presença de indivíduos suscetíveis. Os achados reforçam que a vacinação constitui a principal estratégia para interromper a transmissão do sarampo. Conclui-se que a manutenção de elevada e homogênea cobertura vacinal, associada à vigilância epidemiológica contínua, é indispensável para prevenir novos surtos e sustentar a eliminação da doença no Brasil.

The study aims to understand the historical patterns of measles disease control and resurgence, using a transparent and reproducible framework. The methods include a code package with data manifests, lock records, confirmatory outputs, derived tables, and a script to recompute the main result. title: Loss of measles elimination in a century of post-control resurgence: full preregistration of confirmatory analyses (preregistration 2 of 2)
abstract: This is the second of two preregistrations of one project (preregistration 1: https://osf.io/xtwjc). It registers, before any confirmatory analysis is run, the hypotheses with their support and refutation criteria, the frozen code and configuration files identified by SHA-256 hashes and timestamped lock records, the configurations selected by two pre-registered model searches, the decision rules and the evidence gate, and the sealing of the test period 2023–2026. Part A asks whether the amplitude and the onset hazard of resurgence after control of immunisable diseases follow a common law driven by the accumulation of susceptible births (C1). Part B builds a lead-time-stratified risk assessment of loss of measles elimination status (H1), examines adult immunity gaps (H2) and importation pressure (H3), and places the 2025–26 measles resurgence in the United States within a century of post-control resurgences (H4). All development used data up to 31 December 2022. Test-period performance has not been computed for any analysis, and the code refuses to compute it until this registration has an OSF registration number. Deviations registered before registration (DV01–DV19), prior data access and the addenda to be posted after registration are listed in the text.

It registers, before any confirmatory analysis is run, the hypotheses with their support and refutation criteria, the frozen code and configuration files identified by SHA-256 hashes and timestamped lock records, the configurations selected by two pre-registered model searches, the decision rules and the evidence gate, and the sealing of the test period 2023–2026. Part A asks whether the amplitude and the onset hazard of resurgence after control of immunisable diseases follow a common law driven by the accumulation of susceptible births (C1). Part B builds a lead-time-stratified risk assessment of loss of measles elimination status (H1), examines adult immunity gaps (H2) and importation pressure (H3), and places the 2025–26 measles resurgence in the United States within a century of post-control resurgences (H4). All development used data up to 31 December 2022. Test-period performance has not been computed for any analysis, and the code refuses to compute it until this registration has an OSF registration number. Deviations registered before registration (DV01–DV19), prior data access and the addenda to be posted after registration are listed in the text.

title: Association between residence in flood-prone areas and incomplete childhood vaccination in Bangladesh.
abstract: Flooding events, closely linked to climate change and variability, can disrupt communities and health systems. Vaccination, a highly effective public health intervention, plays a crucial role in preventing child mortality worldwide. However, the relationship between flood-prone residence and early childhood vaccination remains underexplored. This study combines flood exposure data from the Global Flood Database with five waves of Demographic and Health Surveys (2004-2018) in Bangladesh, including vaccination histories for children under three years. Using geographic coordinates, households were matched to spatial flood data to identify whether children lived in flood-prone areas. Generalized Estimating Equations were applied, accounting for geographic clustering, to assess the association between flood exposure and incomplete vaccination overall, as well as by vaccine type and dose. The total sample included 19,021 children, with 12,930 of them being over 1 years old and included in the main analysis. Of those over one year, 16% were defined as living in flood-prone areas, and 84% were fully vaccinated. Children in flood-prone areas had a higher risk of missing the diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTP; PR = 1.34, CI: 1.11-1.62) vaccine, the bacille Calmette-Guerin (BCG; PR = 1.24, CI: 1.02-1.50) vaccine, and the oral polio vaccine (OPV; PR = 1.32, CI: 1.10-1.59) vaccines. Associations were not precise for the measles-containing vaccine (MCV; PR = 1.11, CI: 0.92-1.35) alone, nor for all four vaccines combined (PR = 1.09, CI: 0.91-1.30). These findings highlight that there is an association between residence in flood prone areas and certain vaccines, highlighting the importance of maintaining access to routine immunization services during floods, which are expected to increase with climate change.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study investigates the association between residence in flood-prone areas and incomplete childhood vaccination in Bangladesh, focusing on the measles virus and related entities. The central question is whether flood exposure affects vaccination completion rates for measles and other vaccines.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review combines flood exposure data from the Global Flood Database with five waves of Demographic and Health Surveys (2004-2018) in Bangladesh, including vaccination histories for children under three years. Geographic coordinates were used to match households to spatial flood data, and Generalized Estimating Equations were applied to account for geographic clustering.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Children living in flood-prone areas had a higher risk of missing the diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTP; PR = 1.34, CI: 1.11-1.62), bacille Calmette-Guerin (BCG; PR = 1.24, CI: 1.02-1.50), and oral polio vaccine (OPV; PR = 1.32, CI: 1.10-1.59) vaccines. However, the association was not precise for the measles-containing vaccine (MCV; PR = 1.11, CI: 0.92-1.35) alone, nor for all four vaccines combined (PR = 1.09, CI: 0.91-1.30).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study does not provide precise associations for the measles-containing vaccine alone or for all four vaccines combined, indicating a potential evidence gap. title_zh: 孟加拉国,居住在洪水易发地区与不完整童年 疫苗接种 之间的关联。
source_body_en: Flooding events, closely linked to climate change and variability, can disrupt communities and health systems. Vaccination, a highly effective public health intervention, plays a crucial role in preventing child mortality worldwide. However, the relationship between flood-prone residence and early childhood vaccination remains underexplored. This study combines flood exposure data from the Global Flood Database with five waves of Demographic and Health Surveys (2004-2018) in Bangladesh, including vaccination histories for children under three years. Using geographic coordinates, households were matched to spatial flood data to identify whether children lived in flood-prone areas. Generalized Estimating Equations were applied, accounting for geographic clustering, to assess the association between flood exposure and incomplete vaccination overall, as well as by vaccine type and dose. The total sample included 19,021 children, with 12,930 of them being over 1 years old and included in the main analysis. Of those over one year, 16% were defined as living in flood-prone areas, and 84% were fully vaccinated. Children in flood-prone areas had a higher risk of missing the diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTP; PR = 1.34, CI: 1.11-1.62) vaccine, the bacille Calmette-Guerin (BCG; PR = 1.24, CI: 1.02-1.50) vaccine, and the oral polio vaccine (OPV; PR = 1.32, CI: 1.10-1.59) vaccines. Associations were not precise for the measles-containing vaccine (MCV; PR = 1.11, CI: 0.92-1.35) alone, nor for all four vaccines combined (PR = 1.09, CI: 0.91-1.30). These findings highlight that there is an association between residence in flood prone areas and certain vaccines, highlighting the importance of maintaining access to routine immunization services during floods, which are expected to increase with climate change.
abstract_zh: 与气候变化和变异密切相关的洪水事件可能会扰乱社区和卫生系统。疫苗接种 是一种高效的公共卫生干预措施,在全球预防儿童 死亡率 方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而,洪水多发的居住地与幼儿 疫苗接种 之间的关系仍未得到充分探索。本研究将全球洪水数据库的洪水暴露数据与孟加拉国五波人口和健康调查(2004-2018 年)结合起来,其中包括三岁以下儿童的 疫苗接种 历史记录。使用地理坐标,将家庭与空间洪水数据进行匹配,以确定儿童是否生活在洪水易发地区。应用广义估计方程,考虑地理聚类,评估洪水暴露与不完整 疫苗接种 整体以及 疫苗 类型和剂量之间的关联。样本总数为19,021名儿童,其中1岁以上儿童12,930名,纳入主要分析。在一年以上的人中,16% 的人生活在洪水易发地区,84% 的人已完全接种疫苗。洪水易发地区的儿童错过白喉-破伤风-百日咳 (DTP;PR = 1.34,CI: 1.11-1.62) 疫苗、卡介苗 (BCG;PR = 1.24,CI: 1.02-1.50) 疫苗 和口服脊髓灰质炎的风险较高疫苗(OPV;PR = 1.32,CI:1.10-1.59)疫苗。对于单独包含 麻疹 的 疫苗(MCV;PR = 1.11,CI:0.92-1.35)或所有四个 疫苗 组合(PR = 1.09,CI:0.91-1.30),关联并不精确。这些发现强调,洪水易发地区的居住与某些 疫苗 之间存在关联,强调了在洪水期间保持获得常规免疫服务的重要性,预计洪水将随着气候变化而增加。

title: Microarray patches for transdermal drug delivery: a critical narrative review of technological innovations, CMC challenges, clinical translation, and global health implementation
abstract: Microarray patches (MAPs), alternatively known as microneedle patches, is a paradigm shift in the administration of pharmaceutical agents and vaccines. By utilising micron-scale projections to breach the stratum corneum, MAPs bridge the gap between the convenience of transdermal patches and the efficacy of hypodermic injections. This critical narrative review synthesises advances in MAP technology for transdermal drug delivery, focusing on technological innovations, chemistry, manufacturing, and control (CMC) challenges, clinical translation, regulatory considerations, and global health implementation. Special emphasis is placed on CMC challenges, including sterilisation and stability profiling, as well as the landscape of Clinical Trials, highlighting recent frameworks for pivotal Phase III studies in measles and rubella. We conclude by evaluating the programmatic suitability of MAPs for low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), addressing critical barriers such as cold-chain logistics and trypanophobia. A coordinated evolution from product-by-product model to platform-industrialisation model involving vaccine, polymer and device producing companies, regulators, global-health agencies including World health organization (WHO), and technology enablers is necessary. The Measles-Rubella programme provides an important template. MAPs’ value is not about replacing a syringe but enabling equitable distribution of vaccination; a strategy to make vaccination less dependent on infrastructure. As scientific innovations, upscaling, unified regulatory frameworks and equitable access advance, MAPs will achieve global relevance.

title_zh: 用于透皮给药的微阵列贴片:对技术创新、CMC 挑战、临床转化和全球健康实施的批判性叙述回顾
source_body_en: Microarray patches (MAPs), alternatively known as microneedle patches, is a paradigm shift in the administration of pharmaceutical agents and vaccines. By utilising micron-scale projections to breach the stratum corneum, MAPs bridge the gap between the convenience of transdermal patches and the efficacy of hypodermic injections. This critical narrative review synthesises advances in MAP technology for transdermal drug delivery, focusing on technological innovations, chemistry, manufacturing, and control (CMC) challenges, clinical translation, regulatory considerations, and global health implementation. Special emphasis is placed on CMC challenges, including sterilisation and stability profiling, as well as the landscape of Clinical Trials, highlighting recent frameworks for pivotal Phase III studies in measles and rubella. We conclude by evaluating the programmatic suitability of MAPs for low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), addressing critical barriers such as cold-chain logistics and trypanophobia. A coordinated evolution from product-by-product model to platform-industrialisation model involving vaccine, polymer and device producing companies, regulators, global-health agencies including World health organization (WHO), and technology enablers is necessary. The Measles-Rubella programme provides an important template. MAPs’ value is not about replacing a syringe but enabling equitable distribution of vaccination; a strategy to make vaccination less dependent on infrastructure. As scientific innovations, upscaling, unified regulatory frameworks and equitable access advance, MAPs will achieve global relevance.

title: Bridging microbiology and public health through simulation-based learning.
abstract: Within our synchronous, online global health-focused upper-level microbiology course, we find that students struggle to translate learning to real-world applications. For example, consider the recent measles outbreaks and major events such as the COVID-19 pandemic, which prompt many questions about how basic microbiological information is used by public health professionals. To address these points, we created a simulation-based curriculum that places students in an action role during an infectious disease outbreak. Our stand-alone curriculum walks through a historical measles outbreak that introduces outbreak investigation, community communication, and how these depend on microbiological knowledge. By using breakout groups, students have an opportunity to decide classifications, public messaging, and intervention metrics. We provide students with an outbreak investigation reference worksheet and interweave breakout rooms with didactic vignettes covering background information while revealing actual responses to outbreaks in conjunction with data obtained by responding scientists. Students synthesize material and apply it in real-time, allowing them to exercise critical thinking. Pilot testing in a small, upper-division, virtual classroom suggests that this curriculum has strong potential for increasing mastery of learning objectives and bolstering the relevance of microbiology and public health to popular media.
journal: Journal of Microbiology and Biology Education
